blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A geometric style learned from one family of shapes is typically applied to new shapes from the same family. We consider a more challenging setting: learning the geometric design language of a stylized Latin alphabet and applying it to new forms, from Greek glyphs to entirely different structures such as human poses. We introduce Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer, where the forms to which a learned geometric style can be applied are not restricted to the shape family in which that style was observed. This setting is deceptively challenging: the difficulty is not merely learning a style, but learning the style without learning the shape family in which it was observed. We represent target forms by structural sketches and disentangle structural adherence from style realization using a Geometry LoRA and a style-specific LoRA. Critically, open-form transfer requires the Geometry LoRA to be universal. To achieve this, we devise a geometry-enrichment strategy that constructs a large and purposefully diverse collection of synthetic structural sketches spanning a broad range of unfamiliar geometries. Our experiments and ablations demonstrate the importance of both disentanglement and this universal geometry prior, enabling geometric styles learned from glyphs, pictograms, and other shape families to be transferred to substantially different, unseen forms.

blocks.en:
Style transfer is a long-standing and intriguing problem in visual computing:
given examples that contain both content and style, the goal is to capture the
essence of the style, separate it from the particular content on which it is
observed, and apply it to new content. The separation of style from content has
been studied for decades [ 8 , 7 ] , and has more
recently become central to neural style transfer and generative
modeling [ 13 , 27 , 15 ] .
At the heart of the problem lies the ability to distinguish what is
represented from how it is expressed .

blocks.en:
In this work, we focus on geometric style , where style governs how an
underlying structure is geometrically realized. A canonical example is a font:
different glyphs have different structures, yet their geometric realizations
follow a coherent design language that makes them immediately recognizable as
belonging to the same font. More generally, such geometric styles cannot be
inferred from a single example; it is revealed through a collection of different
shapes that share the same design language. Early work has considered related
notions of separating style from content and transferring geometric style across
shapes [ 25 , 9 ] .

Existing approaches [ 22 , 29 , 26 ] typically learn and apply such styles within a shared domain: a style observed on letters is transferred to other letters, and a style observed on human figures is applied to other human figures.
We remove this restriction and consider transferring a geometric style to an open space of forms .
As illustrated in Figure Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer , a style learned from a
Latin alphabet may be applied to Greek glyphs, or more radically, to human
poses; conversely, a geometric style learned from pictograms may be applied to
glyphs. We call this new setting Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer ,
where the forms to which a learned geometric style can be applied are not
restricted to the shape family in which that style was observed. We focus on
forms whose underlying structure can be represented by a sparse structural
sketch, which serves as the geometry to be styled.

blocks.en:
The open-form setting, illustrated in Figure 2 , is deceptively challenging.
The difficulty is not simply learning a style, but learning the style
without learning the shape family in which that style was observed .
Existing font-generation methods can transfer styles to unseen
glyphs [ 29 , 26 , 32 , 18 ] , and some explicitly
separate character content from style. However, their structural component is
learned and evaluated largely within the glyph domain, often within a single
writing system. This distinction becomes critical when the target form leaves
the source domain.
A straightforward LoRA trained on a limited styled shape family learns an entangled
style with the geometries observed at training (Sec. 4.2 ), causing it
to drift toward familiar source-domain shapes when presented with substantially
different target geometries.

blocks.en:
Our approach addresses this entanglement by separating structural adherence from style realization .
A Geometry LoRA is responsible for faithfully following the target structural sketch serving as a geometric-adherence prior, while a Style LoRA learns how that geometry should be realized in the desired style.
Accordingly, the Geometry LoRA must be universal : generalize across the vast universe of styles, responding to structure rather than shape identity or residual stylistic cues.
Acquiring such a universal geometry prior is itself non-trivial: a corpus of ordinary glyphs provides a limited and familiar geometry vocabulary, allowing the model to recognize known shapes rather than truly follow the input structure.
We therefore introduce a geometry-enrichment strategy (GEE Sec. 3.2 ) that systematically leverages SVG font data to construct a large collection of unfamiliar synthetic geometries, untangled from their source style.
This strategy proves vital for successfully learning a universal geometry LoRA.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce Open-Form Geometric Stylization , where a geometric style learned from one shape domain is applied to universally arbitrary forms. • We show that open-form stylization requires separating structural adherence from style realization. • Finally, we introduce a geometry-enrichment strategy for constructing the broad and diverse structural training distribution needed to acquire this universal prior. We evaluate these ideas through controlled ablations and increasingly challenging transfers, from held-out glyphs and cross-alphabet transfer to unrelated forms such as human poses, demonstrating that a geometric style can be extended well beyond the family of shapes on which it was observed.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en:
Our work builds on three lines of research: the separation of style and
content, font and glyph style transfer, and structurally conditioned
generation. Below we review each line, clarify how our notion of geometric style relates to them, and how they relate to our approach.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作建立在三条研究线的基础上:风格的分离和
内容、字体和glyph样式传输,以及结构条件化
生成。 下面我们回顾每一行,澄清我们的几何风格概念与它们的关系,以及它们与我们的方法的关系。

blocks.en: 2.1 Style and Content
blocks.zh: 2.1 样式和内容

blocks.en:
Our work is closely connected to the seminal work of Tenenbaum and
Freeman [ 25 ] on separating style and content.
Using bilinear models, they showed that a common style can be inferred from
multiple observations and applied to new content. Particularly relevant to
our setting is their treatment of fonts, where style is shared across
different letters and can be used to synthesize previously unseen characters.
This provides an early and elegant formulation of style as a factor that can
be learned across a family of shapes and separated from their individual
geometry. Our work builds on this perspective, but considers an open-form
setting in which the new content need not belong to the same family: a
geometric style learned from one alphabet may be applied to another alphabet,
or even to a different class of structures such as human poses.

blocks.en:
More broadly, style transfer has a long history in computer vision and
graphics, with much of the literature focusing on style as visual appearance.
Early example-based methods [ 8 , 7 ] synthesized and transferred texture by sampling local neighborhoods or patches
from example images. [ 13 ] later introduced neural style transfer, demonstrating that content and artistic style can be represented separately within a deep network and recombined to render new content in the appearance of a reference image. Recent diffusion-based methods
such as StyleAligned [ 15 ] , B-LoRA [ 10 ] ,
InstantStyle [ 28 ] , and ZipLoRA [ 24 ] substantially extend the quality and flexibility of reference-based style
transfer. Across these works, style is predominantly expressed through visual
appearance, including texture, color, material, brushwork, and shading.

Our notion of geometric style is different. Here, style determines how
an underlying structure is geometrically realized: how curves are formed,
junctions are connected, strokes vary in thickness, gaps are introduced, and
structural elements terminate or interact. Such a style is naturally revealed
by a set of related shapes rather than by a single reference image.
Glyphs provide a particularly clean instance of this setting: individual
characters differ in structure, while together they reveal a consistent
geometric design language. Related notions of transferring geometric style
across shapes were also explored in early work by [ 9 ] .
More recently, geometric stylization has also been explored for 3D shapes [ 5 ] .

blocks.en: 2.2 Font and Glyph Style Transfer
blocks.zh: 2.2 字体和文字样式传输

blocks.en:
Modern font-generation methods provide the closest setting to our work, as
they explicitly transfer a common style across glyphs with different
structures. FontDiffuser [ 29 ] formulates one-shot
diffusion-based font generation, using multi-scale content aggregation to
preserve character structure and contrastive learning to capture style. It
generalizes to unseen characters and also demonstrates cross-lingual
generation. MX-Font [ 22 ] addresses few-shot font generation using multiple
localized experts that disentangle content and style while capturing different local style characteristics.
It also demonstrates cross-lingual generalization to unseen writing systems.
VecFusion [ 26 ] approaches font generation in the
vector domain, explicitly modeling glyph topology, paths, and Bézier control
points, and supports applications including glyph completion and few-shot
style transfer. Skeleton-Guided Diffusion [ 32 ] is particularly
related to our structural representation, using character skeletons to guide
diffusion and preserve structure during font generation. StrokeStyles [ 1 ] decomposes font glyphs into
meaningful stroke structures and uses this representation for consistent
geometric stylization across characters.

FLUX-Font [ 18 ] is particularly close to our work architecturally.
It adapts a pre-trained diffusion transformer using separate LoRA
modules [ 17 ] for glyph content and style, explicitly separating
the two factors rather than learning them through a single adapter. Our method
shares this general motivation, but separates structural adherence from style
realization hierarchically: a universal Geometry LoRA is first trained to
follow arbitrary structural sketches, and each Style LoRA is subsequently
learned with this geometry prior active and fixed.

blocks.en:
Despite their differences, these methods share an important restriction:
their structural representations and learned priors are designed for the
glyph domain. Their goal is to generalize from observed characters to other
characters, possibly across writing systems, but the target remains a glyph.
Open-form transfer removes this restriction. The target structural sketch may
describe a character, a pictogram, a human pose, or another unrelated form.
Consequently, separating content from style within the font domain is not
sufficient; the geometry-following component must itself generalize beyond
the shape family in which the style was observed.

blocks.en: 2.3 Structural Conditioning
blocks.zh: 2.3 结构条件

blocks.en:
Spatially conditioned diffusion models provide a complementary line of related
work. ControlNet [ 31 ] and
T2I-Adapter [ 20 ] condition pre-trained text-to-image models
on spatial signals such as edges, depth, segmentation, poses, and sketches,
while Sketch-Guided Diffusion [ 27 ] focuses specifically on
generation controlled by free-form sketches. These methods demonstrate that
strong spatial adherence can be learned over broad image distributions.
blocks.zh:
具有空间条件的传播模型提供了相关系列的补充。
工作时 控制网[31]和
T2I- Adapter [20] 条件预试文本到图像模型
关于空间信号,如边缘、深度、分块、姿势和草图,
而Sketch-Guided diffusion [27] 则特别侧重于
由自由形式草图控制生成。 这些方法表明,
通过广泛的图像分布,可以了解强烈的空间坚持性。

blocks.en:
Our problem, however, is not spatial conditioning alone. The structural sketch
specifies a form whose geometric realization must change according to a style
learned from a separate set of examples. The challenge is therefore to preserve
the target structure while preventing the learned style from carrying with it
the shape distribution on which that style was observed. We use structural
conditioning as a means toward this goal, learning a universal geometry prior
that remains fixed while different geometric styles are acquired. At inference,
we treat structure and style as independent conditions and adopt the
dual-conditioning guidance of InstructPix2Pix [ 3 ] , allowing
their strengths to be controlled separately.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Given a collection of shapes sharing a geometric style, our goal is to learn that style and apply it to a new target form specified by a structural sketch.
We use the term sketch-glyph for a pair consisting of a structural sketch and its styled realization.
The term originates naturally from fonts, where a sketch specifies the structure of a character and the glyph realizes it in a particular font. In this work, we extend this notion to pictograms,
symbols, and other structured forms that are not letters.
Given a small collection of sketch-glyph pairs sharing a style, we aim to realize arbitrary new structural sketches in that style, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh:
鉴于各种形状都具有几何风格,我们的目标是学习这种风格,并将其应用于由结构草图所指定的新的目标形式.
我们使用草图-glyph一词来表示一对由结构草图及其有风格的实现组成的一对.
该名词自然地起源于字体,其中一幅草图指定了一个字符的结构,而glyph在某一特定字体中实现. 在这部作品中,我们把这个概念扩展到了象形图,
符号,以及非字母的其他结构化形式。
由于草图-glyph的一对小集分享了一种风格,我们的目标是实现这种风格中任意的新结构草图,如图2所示。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 provides an overview of the method. Our key design is to separate the two responsibilities involved in this task.
A Universal Geometry LoRA (UGL) provides a general ability to faithfully follow the input structural sketch, while a Style LoRA learns how the conditioned geometry should be realized in the target style.
The two adapters are learned hierarchically rather than independently.
UGL is trained once (Fig. 3 ii ); each Style LoRA is subsequently trained on top of the frozen UGL (Fig. 3 iii ).

一个通用几何LORA(UGL)提供了忠实地跟随输入结构素描的一般能力,而StyleLORA则学习如何在目标样式中实现条件几何.

UGL接受过一次训练(图3 ii;每个Style LoRA随后在被冷冻的UGL上接受训练(图3 ii).

blocks.en: For this separation to support open-form transfer, UGL itself must generalize far beyond any particular shape family. We therefore train it on a large and purposefully diverse collection of synthetic geometries constructed by our Geometry Enrichment Engine (GEE) (Fig. 3 i ).
blocks.zh: 为了支持开放式形式转让,UGL本身必须超越任何特定的外形家族。 因此,我们把它训练成由我们的几何浓缩发动机(图3一)建造的大型和有目的地多样化的合成几何体。

blocks.en:
At inference (Fig. 3 iv ), UGL and the selected
Style LoRA are applied jointly. Their contributions can be controlled independently through
separate geometry and style guidance scales, allowing us to balance adherence
to the target structure against the strength of its stylistic realization.
The following sections describe UGL, GEE, and Style LoRA training in detail.

blocks.en: 3.1 Universal Geometry LoRA (UGL)
blocks.zh: 3.1 通用几何LORA(UGL)

blocks.en:
The purpose of UGL is to fine-tune a text-to-image diffusion model to follow open-form geometries (i.e. sketches).
Starting from a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion transformer (DiT), we fit LoRA parameters on the DiT’s weights using sketch-glyph data pairs constructed by GEE.
The rich, diverse synthetic data produced by the GEE allows us to select a high LoRA rank without overfitting, giving the UGL significant learning capacity.
After this one-time training, we freeze UGL and share it across all Style LoRAs, providing a common geometry prior beyond each style’s specific training examples.
blocks.zh:
UGL的目的是微调文本到图像的传播模型,以遵循开放的形态地貌(即草图).
从预先训练的文本到图像传播变压器(DiT)开始,我们使用由GEE所构建的草图-glyph数据对,在DiT的权重上安装了LORA参数.
GEE制作的丰富多彩的合成数据,使我们能够在不过度适应的情况下选择高的LORA排名,赋予UGL很大的学习能力.
经过这一次的训练后,我们冻结UGL,并分享到所有的Style LoRAs,提供一种超越每个样式具体训练实例的通用几何学。

blocks.en: 3.2 Geometry Enrichment Engine (GEE)
blocks.zh: 3.2 几何浓缩发动机

(b) Reapplying the recipe to font j j produces the same underlying construction in another style.
(c) Skeleton extraction yields a conditioning sketch from j j , which is paired with the target glyph from i i .

blocks.en:
Fonts are a natural starting point for data augmentation: they are available in a large variety of styles, and more importantly, their SVG native representation enables truly geometric augmentations compared to raster form.
However, using real font glyphs directly presents two limitations. First, available fonts cover a relatively narrow set of languages and therefore a limited vocabulary of structures, which may hinder generalization to unseen scripts and, even more, to out-of-domain forms such as symbols or pictograms.
Second, the geometry of a glyph is itself tied to the style of its source font, so the conditioning structure may carry unwanted stylistic cues.
To address both issues, we introduce GEE : a data-generation procedure that expands the range of training geometries while reducing their dependence on font style.
To increase structural diversity, GEE takes advantage of the native SVG parameterization of fonts and constructs novel geometric forms by applying random sequences of geometric edits.
We refer to each such sequence as a geometric recipe .
A recipe may, for example, repeatedly remove or merge SVG parts, producing coherent but unfamiliar structures (Fig. 4 (a)).
Recipes also allow the GEE to address the second problem. A recipe applied to one font can be re-applied to matching letters from another font, producing paired data with similar structure but different styles (Fig. 4 (b)).
During UGL training, we form mixed pairs by taking the conditioning sketch from one font and the target from another font to which the same recipe was applied (Fig. 4 (c)).
The sketch and target therefore remain aligned in structure while differing in style, encouraging UGL to learn the supplied geometry independently of its stylistic realization.

然而,使用真正的字体glyph直接提出了两个限制. 首先,可得到的字体覆盖了相对狭义的一组语言,因此结构词汇有限,这可能会阻碍对隐形脚本的通俗化,甚至更会阻碍对符号或象形图等域外形式.

为了增加结构多样性,GEE利用了字体的原生SVG参数化,通过应用几何编辑的随机序列来构建出新几何形式.
我们把每个序列都称为几何配方。
例如,一种配方可能反复去除或合并SVG部件,产生连贯而陌生的结构(图4(a))。

blocks.en: We next describe the editing primitives that drive the geometry enrichment process, first motivating their design and then outlining each one (full details in Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 接下来我们描述推动几何浓缩过程的编辑原始物,首先激发其设计,然后概述每个原始物(附录C中的全部细节)。

blocks.en: A glyph’s structure is determined by how its strokes relate: which strokes meet and where they branch or terminate. Smooth transformations such as warping, shearing, or scaling can change a glyph’s appearance, but they do not create new structural relations between its strokes. To generate genuinely new structures, we therefore need operations that modify these relations. We propose two elementary edits: component removal and merging. This builds on a broader principle: deleting and recombining existing parts can generate meaningful structural variation [ 11 ] , and related cut-based augmentations have been shown to improve recognition performance [ 6 , 30 ] . Repeating these edits produces novel structural relations beyond those found in existing alphabets.
blocks.zh: 甘油的结构取决于其中风的关联性:是哪个中风相会,在哪里会分枝或终止. 平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 因此,为了产生真正的新结构,我们需要改变这种关系的行动。 我们提议进行两个基本编辑:组件去除和合并。 这基于一个更广泛的原则:删除并重新组合现有部件可产生有意义的结构变异[11],相关的切入式增强已被证明可提高识别性能[6,30]. 重复这些编辑产生新的结构关系,超越了现有字母表中所发现的.

blocks.en: To make both edits transferable across fonts, we edit the glyph’s structure rather than its contour, which is more sensitive to stylistic variation. We therefore represent each glyph as a graph, with strokes as edges and intersections and endpoints as nodes. A recipe is then expressed as a sequence of graph edits, with component removal and merging each applied one to three times. The edit type and its structural parameters are sampled when the recipe is created, specifying which component to remove or where components should connect. Because the edits are defined structurally, the same recipe can be replayed across fonts to produce the same underlying structure in multiple styles. Structural correspondence across styles is further explained in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 为了让两种编辑可以跨出字体,我们编辑glyph的结构,而不是其轮廓,后者对结构变异比较敏感. 因此,我们把每个格子作为图表来代表,把中风作为边缘和相交点,把终点作为节点. 然后将一个食谱表示为图编辑的顺序,组件去除并合并每个应用的一到三次. 在创建食谱时对编辑类型及其结构参数进行采样,指定要删除的组件或者组件应该连接的地方. 因为编辑是结构上定义的,所以同样的食谱可以跨字体重放,在多样式中产生相同的基础结构. 附录C进一步解释了不同风格的结构对应关系。

blocks.en: We represent each glyph as a graph that captures its dominant stroke structure (Fig. 5 ). Starting from the glyph (a), we compute its medial axis together with the local inscribed-disk radius, which provides an estimate of stroke thickness (b). We prune short branches caused by serifs and other stylistic details, leaving the main stroke structure (c). Pixel chains are then collapsed into edges, with junctions and stroke endpoints represented as nod es (d). Finally, we classify each edge by its structural role: an edge between two junctions is a bar , while an edge from a junction to an endpoint is a leg (e).
blocks.zh: 我们代表每个glyph作为图来捕捉它的主要中风结构(图5). 从glyph (a) 开始,我们计算它的中轴线与局部的刻入盘半径,该半径提供了中风厚度的估计值(b). 我们由静脉结构和其他结构细节引起的短枝,留下主中风结构(c). 然后像素链被倒塌成边缘,以相接点和中风端点作为点点 (d)来表示. 最后,我们按其结构作用对每个边缘进行分类:两个相交点之间的边缘是条形,而从相交点到终点的边缘是条腿(e).

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Graph extraction. The steps of extracting a structural graph from a glyph, shown for two glyphs. Columns labelled as referenced in Sec. 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 图5:图表提取。 从一格取出结构图的步骤,显示为两个格. 标记为第3.2节所引用的列。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Component removal. The steps of removing one structural component, shown for two glyphs. Columns labelled as referenced in Sec. 3.2 .

blocks.en: Fig. 6 illustrates the process. Our strategy is to perform the edit in the medial-axis representation and then reconstruct the glyph back in the SVG domain. Outline points unrelated to the removed component are preserved exactly. Only the region surrounding the cut is reconstructed, where additional processing is needed to obtain a clean, style-consistent boundary. Using the graph extracted in the previous step, we locate the component to remove from its structure, which lets us find the same component across styles (a). As seen in Fig. 6 (b), simply removing the red branch can leave bulges where it connects to the remaining blue branches. We therefore trim these regions and reconnect the remaining blue branches. We then separate the pixels belonging to the removed region from those that should remain (c). This produces a pixel removal mask, which we convert to a smooth vector representation (d).Additional reconstruction steps are described in the appendix. The final removal result is shown in (e).

blocks.en: Fig. 7 illustrates the process. We begin with two glyphs from the same style: a guest (a) and a host (b), and aim to combine them into a single coherent glyph. As in component removal, we perform the edit in the medial-axis representation and reconstruct the result in the SVG domain. Using the graphs extracted in the previous step, we identify where the guest should connect to the host based on their structural attributes. The process starts by randomly generating a candidate merging recipe, combining a set of simple augmentations, such as mirroring, rotation, and scaling, with a pair of connection points selected from the guest and host graphs, shown as red points in (c,d). To assess the result produced by the recipe, we apply the augmentations and connect the glyphs at the selected points. We approve only recipes that produce a clean, coherent shape (e). A merging recipe is retained only if it succeeds across a minimum number of styles. Additional implementation details are provided in the appendix. The final merging result is shown in (f).
blocks.zh: 图7说明了这一进程。 我们从同一种风格的两种格言开始:一是来宾(a)和一是主机(b),目的是将它们结合成一个统一的格言. 和组件去除一样,我们在介质轴代表中进行编辑,并重建SVG域中的结果. 使用前一步所提取的图表,我们根据嘉宾的结构属性,确定嘉宾应在哪里与主机相接. 这一过程首先随机生成一个候选合并食谱,结合了一组简单的增强,如镜像,旋转和缩放等,从来宾和主机图表中选择一对连接点,在(c,d)中显示为红色分. 为了评估食谱产生的结果,我们应用了增量并连接了所选点的甘油. 我们只批准能够产生干净、连贯形状(e)的食谱。 合并的食谱只有在经过最低限度的样式后才能被保留. 附录中提供了其他执行细节。 最后合并结果见(f)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Style LoRA
blocks.zh: 3.3 样式 LORA

blocks.en:
We train a separate Style LoRA on sketch-glyph pairs
for each target style, as shown in Fig. 3 (iii). The backbone
and UGL parameters remain fixed, while UGL continues to guide the geometry
throughout training. Only the Style LoRA is optimized, allowing it to focus on how that
geometry is realized in the target style. Here we use a low-rank adapter,
far smaller than UGL: its limited capacity helps keep the style update from
re-learning geometry or competing with the shared geometry prior.
Following previous work [ 12 , 23 ] , we
associate each style with a unique rare token. This token and a short
appearance description provide the textual conditioning during both Style
LoRA training and inference.

blocks.en:
The few style examples also share a limited family of geometries, so the
Style LoRA may still tie the learned style to those geometries despite
UGL’s structural guidance. To preserve open-form transfer, we mix geometry-enriched
sketch-glyph pairs into its training batches, shown by the connection from
GEE to Style LoRA training in Fig. 3 . These pairs expose the
model to geometries outside the target style’s examples throughout adaptation,
reinforcing its ability to follow new structures while learning the style.

blocks.en:
After training, we apply UGL and the selected Style LoRA jointly to the base diffusion model to map structural sketches to styled outputs (Fig. 3 iv ).
To control geometry adherence and style strength separately, we adopt dual classifier-free guidance following InstructPix2Pix [ 3 ] .
During training, the structural sketch, the style caption, or both are dropped to their null conditions, so a single network learns all four conditioning combinations.
During sampling, we combine three forward passes using two CFG coefficients to obtain separate geometry and style guidance strengths, balancing adherence to the input sketch geometry vs. the target style.
Appendix B provides the guidance formulation and implementation details.
blocks.zh:
经过培训后,我们联合将UGL和所选的Style LoRA应用到基础传播模型上来将结构草图映射到有样式的产出上(图3 iv.
为了分别控制几何的坚持和样式强度,我们遵循InstructPix2Pix [3] 采用无分级器的双向导.
在训练期间,结构素描,风格标题,或两者都降为无效条件,所以一个单一的网络可以学习所有四个条件组合.
在采样过程中,我们利用两个CFG系数将三个前行传入组合,以获得单独的几何和样式引导优势,平衡对输入素描几何与目标样式的坚持.
附 录 B提供了指导意见的制定和执行细节。

blocks.en:
This joint application supports transfer to new forms without further training: a pictogram style can depict new human poses, while a sculptural style can turn free-form strokes into tubular shapes (Fig. Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer ).
The same sketch can also be rendered in different learned styles (Fig. 2 ).
Section 4 evaluates these capabilities through qualitative and quantitative comparisons and ablations of the method’s main components.

这种联合应用支持在没有进一步训练的情况下转移到新形式:象形图风格可以描绘出新的人形,而雕塑风格可以将自由形式中风转变为管状外形(图. Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer.
同样的素描也可以用不同的学习风格来提供(图2.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate our method across fonts, pictograms, and object-centric styles, using sketches of increasing structural novelty: • In-domain , held-out test examples from the same source domain as the style training data • Near-domain , semantically related but structurally unseen examples, such as non-Latin glyphs for fonts and everyday human poses for pictograms • Out-of-domain , structures from unrelated shape families, such as non-glyph sketches for font styles or non-human sketches for pictogram styles. We compare against prior methods and perform targeted ablations to assess both open-set transfer quality and the contributions of our main design choices.

blocks.en: 4.1 Training and Evaluation Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训和评价数据

blocks.en: The training data for the universal geometry LoRA (UGL) is produced by the geometry enrichment engine (GEE) from 80 80 base glyphs (Latin letters, Latin Extended letters, and digits) shared across 16 16 fonts. Applying 6,000 6{,}000 random recipes yields 42,705 42{,}705 sketch–glyph pairs, on which UGL is trained once (Appendix D ). Each style is represented by a small exemplar set with manually drawn structural sketches. We hold out six examples per style for evaluation and train the Style LoRA on the remainder, yielding roughly 20–70 sketch–exemplar pairs per style. During Style LoRA training, 10 % 10\% of each batch is replayed from the UGL training pairs using their original style-free captions, helping preserve the learned geometry prior while adapting to style. For evaluation, we use a benchmark of 50 50 curated sketches per style category (fonts and pictograms). To analyze how well our method and the baselines generalize, the sketches span the in-, near-, and out-of-domain tiers defined above. We evaluate across twelve styles, and for each style all methods receive the same sketches and style references.
blocks.zh: 通用几何LORA(UGL)的训练数据由几何浓缩引擎(GEE)从共有16个字体的80个基格(拉丁字母,拉丁扩展字母和数字)中产生. 应用了6000 6{,}000个随机食谱的可生成42,705个42{,}705个草图-glyph配对,其中UGL接受过一次训练(附录 D.). 每个样式都由用手工绘制的结构草图组成的小型实例集来代表. 我们每个样式都举出六个例子进行评估,并在其余的样式上训练Style LORA,每样式产生大约20-70个草图-实例对。 在Style LoRA训练期间,每批10%的10\%从UGL训练配对中重放,使用其原始的无样式字幕来进行回放,帮助在适应样式的同时保留所学几何. 在评价方面,我们采用每个样式类别(fonts和phicograms)50个被整理的草图的基准。 为了分析我们的方法和基线的普及程度,草图覆盖了上面定义的域内、近域和域外各级。 我们评价十二种风格,对于每一种风格,所有方法都得到相同的草图和风格参考.

blocks.en: 4.2 Open-form Geometric Generalization
blocks.zh: 4.2 开放式几何通化

blocks.en: We tailored our main technical contributions, the universal geometry LoRA (UGL) and the geometry enrichment engine (GEE), to open-form generalization and the challenges of fine-tuning large models.
blocks.zh: 我们调整了我们的主要技术贡献,即通用几何LORA(UGL)和几何浓缩引擎(GEE),以开放式通化和微调大型模型的挑战.

blocks.en: In this section, we demonstrate the necessity of both components; later in Table 12 we also present a quantitative evaluation that supports each claim.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们表明了这两个组成部分的必要性;在表12后,我们还提出了支持每项索赔的定量评估。

blocks.en:
We begin with the most direct alternative: avoid the UGL by fine-tuning a single low-rank adapter on the few sketch-glyph pairs available for a given style. While this formulation preserves both the target geometry and the learned style on held-out examples from the same style family , it does not generalize to out-of-domain structures. Instead, the model takes a shortcut by producing results resembling the closest training example, best seen in the bottom rows of Fig. 8 ( w/o UGL ), where the model outputs styled examples similar to English alphabet letters rather than the desired geometry.
Row w/o UGL in Table 12 quantifies this behavior.
blocks.zh:
我们从最直接的可选方案开始:在为数不多的草图-glyph配对上,通过对单个低等适配器进行微调来避免UGL. 虽然这种提法既保留了目标几何学,也保留了同一风格家族中被搁置的例子的所学取的风格,但它并没有概括到域外结构. 取而代之的是,模型通过产生与最接近的训练实例相类似的结果来走捷径,最好在Fig. 8 (w/o UGL.)的下行中出现,模型输出将类似英文字母字母的示例取而代之,而不是所期望的几何.
表12中的w/o UGL行将这种行为量化.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : In-domain comparisons. Each row shows a sketch held out from that style’s training examples, two reference examples of the style, the outputs of the baselines, the ground truth, and our output. The font styles (top) are compared with the dedicated font-generation models, the colorful styles (bottom) with the general-purpose image models.
blocks.zh: 图9:域内比较。 每行都显示从该风格的训练实例中绘制出一幅草图,两个样式的参考实例,基线的输出,地面的真相,以及我们的产出。 字体样式(top)与专用字体生成模型相提并论,多彩样式(下方)与通用图像模型相提并论.

blocks.en: A natural hypothesis for this phenomenon is that each geometry is observed only through a single realization in the target style, providing too little variation to disentangle the geometry and style.
blocks.zh: 这一现象的一个自然假说是,每个几何只通过目标样式的单一实现来观测,提供太多的变异来分解几何和样式.

blocks.en:
An intuitive solution is to train a geometry adapter on ordinary glyphs drawn from a broad corpus of fonts, using the same training settings as UGL but without employing GEE, and then train the same Style LoRAs on top of it.
Unfortunately, the failure persisted, now in an even more revealing form.
The UGL is even more biased towards common geometries from the train set, e.g. alphabet letters, as again seen in the bottom row of the w/o GEE section of Fig 8 .
These results are again supported by data in Table 12 .
blocks.zh:
一个直观的解决方案是用取自一幅宽字体的普通格子来训练一款几何适配器,使用与UGL相同的训练设置,但不使用GEE,然后在它上方训练出同一种样式的LORA.
不幸的是,失败依然存在,现在更加明显。
UGL更偏向于从列车编组中常见的几何图案,例如字母表字母,这在图8的w/o GEE区段下行再次出现.
表12的数据再次证实了这些结果。

blocks.en:
What is instead needed is a training distribution with fewer geometric correlations, preventing the model from capturing a specific shape identity.
This is solved by our second technical contribution (GEE Sec. 3.2 ).
The GEE’s immense augmentation strategy forces the geometry model to rely on the supplied structure rather than recognizing a known geometry.
With this enriched corpus, completing our full method, the out-of-domain score rises to 0.94 0.94 ( Ours in Table 12 ), with a geometry factor of 0.97 0.97 and style within 3% of the ceiling, and the characteristic substitutions largely disappear.
blocks.zh:
相反,需要的是几何关系较少的培训分布,使模型无法捕捉出特定的形状特征。
我们的第二次技术贡献(GEE Sec. 3.2)解决了这个问题。
GEE的巨大增强战略迫使几何模型依赖所提供的结构,而不是承认已知的几何结构。
有了这种丰富度,完成了我们的全部方法,域外分数上升到了0.94 0.94 (我们的表12),几何系数为0.97 0.97,在天花板的3%内呈现出风格,特征替代基本消失.

Baselines often distort these unfamiliar inputs toward known forms or lose structural or stylistic details, while our method follows the supplied geometry and preserves the target style. The zoomed examples highlight reference motifs retained in the outputs, demonstrating transfer beyond the forms seen during style adaptation.

blocks.en: The out-of-domain tier (Fig. 10 ) provides a stronger test by applying pictogram and object-centric styles to structures from unrelated shape families. Across these sketches, our method retains the characteristic shapes and appearance of each style while following the new structure, demonstrating open-form transfer beyond the source domain.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions, Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We introduced Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer, where a geometric style
learned from one family of shapes is applied to structures well beyond that
family. We showed that learning geometric style requires separating how a shape
is realized from the particular geometry on which that style is observed.
However, disentanglement is necessary but not sufficient . To transfer a
geometric language to unseen forms, the geometry component must itself be
universal.

blocks.en:
These findings suggest an asymmetric view of geometry and style. Geometry
should be learned broadly, across a large and diverse space of structures, and
can be learned once as a reusable capability. Style, in contrast, can be learned
from a much narrower collection of examples and specialized independently.
Our Universal Geometry LoRA and Style LoRA instantiate this separation, while
GEE provides the geometric diversity needed to make the former universal.

blocks.en:
As with many fine-tuned generative models, some challenges remain. Complex
structures can expose a tradeoff between geometric and stylistic fidelity, while
strong or recurring stylistic elements can occasionally interfere with the target
structure or become overemphasized. Improving this separation, particularly for
increasingly complex geometries and styles, is an interesting direction for
future work.
We believe this principle may extend beyond geometric style transfer, enabling
learned visual languages to be applied outside the domains in which they were
observed.

blocks.en: Appendix A Further Comparisons
blocks.zh: 附录A 进一步比较

blocks.en: Sec. 4 compares against font-generation models and general-purpose image generators. Here we include additional comparisons with three recent methods that are particularly relevant to our setting. B-LoRA [ 10 ] and ZipLoRA [ 24 ] , like ours, use low-rank adapters to separate what is depicted from how it is rendered, while Abstraction in Style (AiS) [ 19 ] explicitly models structural abstraction as part of stylization. Fig. 13 shows the B-LoRA and ZipLoRA results next to ours for the same sketch and style; AiS is discussed separately below.
blocks.zh: 第4条比较字体生成模型和通用图像生成器。 在此,我们补充了与最近三种方法的比较,这些方法与我们所处的环境特别相关。 B-Lora [10]和ZipLora [24],和我们的一样,使用低等适配器来区分所描绘的东西和如何渲染,而Style (AiS) [19]中的抽象化则明确了结构抽象化的模型,作为分层化的一部分. 图13显示了我们旁边的B-LORA和ZipLORA的结果,用于同样的素描和风格;AiS在下文单独讨论.

blocks.en: B-LoRA leverages LoRA to implicitly separate the style and content of a single image by jointly learning the LoRA weights of two specific SDXL blocks, which can then be used as independent components. We use the official implementation and settings, which we verified by reproducing the authors’ published example. The content adapter is trained on the structural sketch and the style adapter on six training examples of the style, matching the other reference-based baselines. As Fig. 13 (left) shows, the style block carries only the palette and texture of the style: the geometric style is lost, and the structure of the sketch is replaced by hallucinated, unrelated content, because a thin line drawing provides little reconstruction signal.
blocks.zh: B-LORA利用LORA通过共同学习两个SDXL特定块的LORA权重来隐含地分离出单一图像的风格和内容,然后可以用作独立的组件. 我们使用官方执行和设置,我们通过转载作者发表的例子加以核实。 内容适配器在结构素描和风格适配器上接受了关于风格的六个训练实例的培训,与其他基于参考的基线相匹配. 如图13(左)所示,样式块只搭载了样式的调色板和纹理:几何样式已丢失,而素描的结构被幻觉所取代,无关内容,因为细行图提供的重建信号很少.

blocks.en: ZipLoRA merges independently trained style and subject LoRAs by learning per-column merger coefficients that minimize their interference. As no official implementation exists, we implement it on our own backbone, which isolates the merging strategy: the content adapter is our UGL and the style adapter is a Style LoRA trained without the UGL, as in the Non-hierarchical ablation (Sec. 12 ). Both adapters are frozen and only the coefficients are optimized, with the paper’s hyperparameters. With all coefficients at one, the two adapters are simply added, which is exactly the Non-hierarchical configuration of our ablation study; sampling uses its sketches, prompts, seeds and guidance. The learned coefficients scale down both adapters, averaging 0.39 0.39 - 0.48 0.48 for the UGL and 0.24 0.24 - 0.52 0.52 for the Style LoRA across the three styles. As Fig. 13 (right) shows, the result follows the sketch, but the conflict between structure and style remains, only in a milder form: style-specific details such as the pictogram tile and the wedge-shaped terminals of the display font are weakened. Training the Style LoRA with the UGL active, as we do, avoids the conflict altogether.
blocks.zh: ZipLORA通过学习能将干扰最小化的每栏合并系数,将经过独立训练的风格和科目LORA合并. 由于没有正式实施,我们在自己的骨干上执行它,这隔离了合并策略:内容适配器是我们的UGL,而风格适配器是一个没有UGL训练的Style LORA,如"非分级衰减"(sec 12. 两个适配器被冷冻并仅优化系数,并配有纸张的超参数. 以所有系数为一,两个适配器只是被简单地添加了,这恰恰是我国通化研究的非分级配置;采样使用它的草图,活出来,种子和取向. 所学的系数缩小了两个适配器,平均0.39 0.39-0.39 - 048 048 UGL和0.24 0.24 - 0.52 0.52 Style LoRA横跨三种样式. 如图13 (正文)所示,结果沿用了草图,但结构与风格相冲突仍然存在,仅以更温和的形式出现: 显示字体的象形平面和楔形终端等特有风格细节被削弱. 训练Style LoRA与UGL的活跃,我们这样做,完全避免了冲突.

blocks.en: Abstraction in Style (AiS). AiS is designed specifically for styles in which abstraction extends beyond color and texture to geometric and structural deformation. AiS explicitly separates structural abstraction from visual stylization in two stages: it first transforms the target into an intermediate abstraction proxy that reflects the structural tendencies of the reference style, and then renders this proxy into the final stylized output. Both stages are learned from a small set of visual exemplars through its Visual Analogy Transfer framework. This makes AiS particularly relevant to our setting, as it is one of the few recent methods that explicitly treats structural reinterpretation as part of style transfer.
blocks.zh: 风格抽象 (AiS). AiS是专门为抽象超越了颜色和纹理到几何和结构变形的风格而设计的. AiS明确将结构抽象与视觉结构化分出两个阶段:它首先将目标转换为中间抽象代用,反映参考风格的结构倾向,再将这个代用变成最终的结构化输出. 这两个阶段都是通过它的视觉自学转移框架从一小组视觉实例中吸取的. 这使得AiS特别适合我们的设置,因为它是最近少数明确把结构再解释作为风格转移的一部分的方法之一.

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Comparison with AiS. For each framed sketch, the result of AiS [ 19 ] (top) and ours (bottom), for two pictogram styles and a sculptural style.
blocks.zh: 图14:与AiS的比较。 对于每张被设定的草图,AiS[19](上)和我们的(下)的结果,为两种象形图风格和一副雕塑风格.

blocks.en: Fig. 14 compares AiS with our method on three styles: two pictogram sets and a sculptural style. We train AiS on the same style references and use the structural sketch as the abstraction target. AiS captures the visual appearance of each style, but on the pictogram styles its outputs do not reliably follow the sketch: across the scripts, strokes are rearranged, omitted, or fused, while the runner pose is only loosely preserved. On the sculptural style, whose exemplars are themselves single continuous strokes, AiS follows the sketch more closely, though it renders every glyph as one uniform tube. This reflects AiS’s design: its abstraction proxy follows structural tendencies learned from the references rather than the geometry of a specific target. Our method follows each sketch closely while preserving the same style traits, including the tile deformation and stroke bands of the orange set.
blocks.zh: 图14 将AiS与我们的方法相提并论的三种风格:两套相形图和一出雕塑风格. 我们用同样的风格参考来训练AiS,并使用结构素描作为抽象目标. AiS捕捉了每种风格的视觉外观,但在象形图样式上,其输出并不可靠地遵循草图: 在脚本上,中风被重新排列,省略,或被熔化,而跑步姿势则只被松散地保留. 在雕塑风格上,其实例本身是单相连续出击,AiS更紧密地跟随了草图,虽然它使每个格律都成为了统一的管. 这反映了AiS的设计:其抽象代用遵循了从参考文献中吸取的结构倾向,而不是特定目标的几何. 我们的方法在保持同样风格的特质的同时紧密地遵循每张草图,包括橙色片组的瓦片变形和中风带.

blocks.zh: 附录 C 几何 浓缩引擎:细节

blocks.en:
This appendix details the construction of the geometry-enriched training corpus
used to train UGL (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
本附录详细介绍了几何丰富培训大纲的构建情况。
用于训练UGL(第3.2节.

blocks.en:
We begin with 80 80 base glyphs (Latin letters, Latin Extended letters, and digits) shared across 16 16 fonts and treat them
as raw geometric material. We expand this initial vocabulary using two simple
structural operations: component removal , which removes a structural
part of a glyph, and merging , which combines components from two glyphs.
The operations are applied iteratively, allowing newly generated shapes to
participate in subsequent operations. As illustrated in Fig. 4 of Sec. 3.2 , the
resulting forms quickly depart from recognizable characters, producing a much
broader distribution of coherent but unfamiliar geometries.
blocks.zh:
我们从80个底格字母(拉丁字母,拉丁扩展字母,和数字)开始,共有16个字体,并把它们处理
作为原始几何材料。 我们用两个简单的词汇来扩展这个初始词汇
结构操作: 组件去除,它去除结构
和合并,它从两个glyph中结合组件。
操作被反复应用,允许新生成的形状
参加后续行动。 如第3.2条图4所示,
因此,表格迅速脱离了可识别的字符,产生了很多
更广泛分布连贯而陌生的地美图.

blocks.en:
We represent each sequence of structural operations as a geometric
recipe . Importantly, a recipe is defined independently of a particular font
and can therefore be applied to corresponding glyphs across multiple fonts.
This produces related geometric constructions realized in different styles.
Beyond increasing geometric diversity, this correspondence is what allows us to
separate the structural information conveyed by a sketch from the style of its
target realization.
blocks.zh:
我们以几何来代表每个结构操作的顺序
食谱。 重要的是,对食谱的定义独立于特定字体
并因此可以被应用到跨多字体的对应格子上.
这产生了以不同风格实现的相关几何构造.
除了增加几何多样性外,这种对应关系使我们得以
将草图传递的结构信息与其风格区分开来
目标实现。

blocks.en:
A GEE recipe is a sequence of component-removal and merging operations, with both operations applied one to three times. The output of one step is the input of the next.
Both operations share a first step, graph extraction, described next.
blocks.zh:
通用教育方法是一种组件搬运和合并作业的顺序,两种作业都应用了一至三次。 一个步骤的输出是下一个步骤的输入.
这两项行动共同迈出了第一步,即图解取出,下面将加以说明。

blocks.en: Editing a glyph’s outline directly is fragile, since a removal or a join depends on local contour details that differ from style to style. Both operators therefore act on the glyph’s underlying stroke structure, which we extract as a graph; Fig. 5 of Sec. 3.2 illustrates the steps. Starting from the glyph (a), we compute its medial axis transform, which gives the centerline of every stroke together with the radius of the maximal inscribed disk at each point, a local estimate of stroke thickness (b). Treating the axis pixels as a graph, we prune the short branches caused by serifs and other stylistic contour details, retaining the dominant stroke structure (c). Chains of pixels between meeting points are then collapsed into single edges, junctions become nodes and stroke ends become tips (d). Finally, each edge is classified (e). An edge between two junctions is a bar , and an edge from a junction to a tip is a leg . Because these roles do not depend on the exact contour of a style, an operation on these graphs can be replayed across styles.
blocks.zh: 直接编辑 glyph 的大纲很脆弱, 因为删除或加入取决于不同风格的本地轮廓细节 。 因此,这两个操作者都按照Glyph的基本中风结构行事,我们用图表来提取;第3.2节图5说明了步骤。 从glyph (a) 开始,我们计算出它的中轴变换,它使每次中风的中线与每个点上所刻的最大圆盘的半径相接,对中风厚度的局部估计(b). 将轴像素作为图来对待,我们推平了由静脉等位结构和其他等位结构细节引起的短枝,保留了主中风结构(c). 相会点之间的像素链会倒塌为单边,相接点会变成节点,中风端会变成提示(d). 最后,每个边缘都被分类(e). 两个相接点之间的边缘是条,从相接点到尖端的边缘是条腿。 因为这些角色并不依赖于一个样式的准确轮廓,因此在这些图表上操作可以跨样式重放.

blocks.en: A recipe names the component it edits, but only within the style on which it was defined. To apply the same edit consistently across styles, we must identify the corresponding component in each style. We represent the selected component using a compact descriptor consisting of its type (bar or leg), the orientation of the chord connecting its endpoints, its midpoint normalized by the glyph’s bounding box, and its arc length relative to glyph size. For each other style, we compare this descriptor with all removable components of the same type and select the component with the smallest weighted distance, provided that the distance is below a matching tolerance. If no component falls below this tolerance, the recipe is not applied to that style. A recipe is retained only if at least a minimum number of styles remain (we configured as 6).
blocks.zh: 一个食谱命名它编辑的组件,但仅限于它被定义的样式之内. 为了在各种样式中一致地应用同样的编辑,我们必须确定每种样式中相应的组件。 我们使用一个紧凑的描述符来代表选定的成分,这个描述符包括:其类型(巴或腿)、连接其终点的和弦的方向、其中点因glyph的边框而正常化,以及相对于glyph大小的弧长。 对于彼此的风格,我们将这个描述符与同类型的所有可移动组件进行比较,并选择最小加权相距的组件,前提是相距低于相配相容度. 如果没有一个组成部分低于这种容忍度,则配方不适用于这种风格。 只有当至少保留一定数量的样式(我们配置为6)时,方程式才会被保留.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 of Sec. 3.2 illustrates the process step by step. Given the extracted graph, we aim to remove exactly one structural component, such as a leg or bar, while keeping the rest of the outline unchanged and reconstructing the cut in the font’s own terminal style (a). The component to be removed is described by its structural attributes in the graph. In each style, we use these attributes to identify the corresponding component, so that the same component is removed consistently across styles. Removing only the skeleton associated with the component’s edge is not sufficient, since part of its medial axis may also belong to the junction. To avoid leaving an artificial bulge, we remove medial-axis points near the junction within a radius slightly smaller than its inscribed-disk radius (b). This creates a small gap, which we reconnect with a straight stroke that smoothly bridges the surviving branches. We remove pixels belonging to the deleted limb while preserving those shared with surviving strokes. We then fill small junction concavities using the convex hull of the surviving strokes (c). The removal is defined as a pixel mask, but the output must be vectorized. We therefore trace the removal region into a smooth contour and subtract it from the original glyph outline (d). Geometry outside the edited region is preserved exactly. The newly exposed cut boundary has no counterpart in the original glyph. To reconstruct it in a style-consistent way, we search other glyphs from the same font for a matching outline segment, after normalizing for position, scale, and rotation. We then fit this donor segment to the exposed boundary and insert it into the cut region. The result is a glyph with one structural component removed while preserving the original outline wherever possible (e).
blocks.zh: 3.2节图6逐个说明了这一过程。 鉴于所提取的图表,我们的目标是删除一个确切的结构组成部分,例如一条腿或条,同时保持大纲其余部分不变,并在字体本身的终端样式(a)中重建剪接部分。 要去除的组件由图中其结构属性来描述. 在每个样式中,我们使用这些属性来识别相应的组件,这样,同一组件在样式之间一致被去除. 只取出与部件边缘相关的骨架是不够的,因为其中轴线的一部分也可能属于相接点. 为避免留下人造凸起,我们在半径略小于其刻入式磁盘半径(b)的范围内去除相交口附近的中轴点. 这造成了一个小的缺口,我们用一通直通的中风重新连接起来,顺利地连接了幸存的树枝. 我们删除属于被删除的四肢的像素,同时保留那些与幸存中风共用的像素. 然后利用幸存的中风(c)的对流船体来填充小交接孔。 删除被定义为像素遮罩,但输出必须矢量. 因此,我们将清除区域追踪到一个平滑的轮廓,并从原来的格莱弗大纲(d)中减去。 编辑区域外的几何精确保存. 新被曝光的剪接边界在原始格言中没有对应. 为了以符合风格的方式重建它,我们从同一个字体中搜索出相匹配的大纲段,然后使位置、尺度和旋转正常化。 然后,我们把这个捐助部分放入暴露的边界,并插入切割区。 结果是在尽可能保留原大纲(e)的同时去除一个结构组件的格子.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 of Sec. 3.2 illustrates the process. The connection between the two glyphs is described through structural attributes of their graphs. These attributes identify where the guest should attach to the host and allow the corresponding connection to be found across styles. We begin with two glyphs from the same style: a guest g a g_{a} (a) and a host g b g_{b} (b). Our goal is to attach the guest to the host so that they form a single coherent glyph. The merge has two stages. First, we augment the pair, g ^ a = augment ⁡ ( g a ) , g ^ b = augment ⁡ ( g b ) , \hat{g}_{a}=\mathrm{augment}(g_{a}),\quad\hat{g}_{b}=\mathrm{augment}(g_{b}), to generate multiple candidate configurations. The host may be mirrored, while the guest may be also rotated and scaled. These choices are randomly sampled when the recipe is created. In Fig. 7 (c), for example, the host is unchanged while the guest is mirrored and rotated by 270 ∘ 270^{\circ} . We then merge the augmented pair, merge ⁡ ( g ^ a , g ^ b ) . \mathrm{merge}(\hat{g}_{a},\hat{g}_{b}). On the guest, the connection is anchored at a stroke end facing the host, marked by the red dot in Fig. 7 (c). On the host, we select the stroke end facing the guest; if none exists, we use the nearest skeleton point (Fig. 7 (d)). The guest is then translated so that the two connection points align. We keep only merges that form a coherent single shape, with a localized overlap at the junction and no narrow gaps or small enclosed holes, as shown in Fig. 7 (e). A merge recipe is retained only if it succeeds across a minimum number of styles, ensuring that the structural relation transfers consistently. Small fragments extending beyond the seam are removed to produce the final glyph, as shown in Fig. 7 (f).

blocks.en:
For each generated glyph, we extract a structural sketch from its medial axis.
A raw medial axis, however, can retain local characteristics of the font from
which it was extracted, allowing the conditioning sketch to inadvertently
reveal style. We therefore simplify the extracted structure by pruning small
branches associated with local stylistic details and approximating the
remaining structure with a limited set of Bézier curves. During training, we
additionally apply random modifications to these curves. Together, these
operations preserve the dominant structure while making residual stylistic
cues unreliable.
blocks.zh:
对于每个生成的甘油, 我们提取一个结构草图 从它的中轴线。
但是,原始介质轴可以保留字体的本地特性。
它被取出, 允许调制草图 无意中
显示样式。 因此,我们简化了抽取的结构,
与本地结构细节相关的分支和
其余结构,带有一组有限的贝塞尔曲线。 在训练期间,我们
附加对这些曲线进行随机修改。 这些是一起的
操作保持主导结构,同时使残余结构
暗示不可靠。

blocks.en: We now describe the style-suppressing operations in more detail.
blocks.zh: 我们现在更详细地描述风格压制行动.

blocks.en: Pruning. We first remove branches that are more likely to arise from outline decoration than from genuine stroke structure. Pruning is defined relative to the local stroke width rather than by an absolute length threshold. In an initial pass, branches shorter than 0.4 0.4 stroke widths are removed. This suppresses small decorative spurs without systematically eliminating genuinely short structural components. Serifs require separate treatment. At a serif terminal, the medial axis often splits into two short branches on opposite sides of the stroke. Removing either branch independently would shorten the stroke rather than remove only its decoration. We distinguish such serif pairs from genuine bifurcations using the line segment joining the two branch tips. If this segment lies entirely inside the glyph, the branches are treated as the two prongs of a serif. If it exits the glyph, as between the upper arms of a Y , the branches are treated as genuine structure and retained. A detected serif pair is replaced by a single branch between the two prongs, preserving the full stroke extent while discarding the terminal shape. In our fonts, serif branches span at most approximately one stroke width, whereas genuine structural limbs typically span two to five stroke widths. We therefore merge a pair only when both branches are shorter than 1.5 1.5 stroke widths. A final pruning pass removes branches shorter than 0.9 0.9 stroke widths, except where such a branch independently captures a substantial part of the glyph structure.
blocks.zh: 普润. 我们首先去除比出自真中风结构 更有可能由轮廓装饰产生的树枝。 Pruning是相对于局部中风宽度而不是绝对长度阈值来定义的. 在初始通路中,切出长度短于0.40.4中风宽度的分枝. 这抑制了小的装饰刺激,而没有系统地消除真正短的结构成分. 塞里夫斯需要单独治疗. 在一个serif终端上,介质轴经常会分出中风相向的两条短枝. 独立去除任何分支都会缩短中风,而不是只去掉它的装饰. 我们用连接两个分线的线段 来区分这种线段和真正的分线 如果这一段完全位于格子内,枝被作为活塞活塞的两个柱子来对待. 如果它离开glyph,在一Y的上臂之间,枝被作为真结构对待并保留. 被探测到的serif对被两个道道之间的单分支所取而代之,在丢弃终端外形的同时保留了全中风范围. 在我们的字体中,静脉分支的长度最多约为一中风宽度,而真正的结构肢通常为二至五中风宽度。 因此,只有在两个分支都短于1.5个中风宽度时,我们才合并一对. 出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出

blocks.en: Representational bottleneck. We next approximate the pruned medial axis with a limited number of cubic Bézier curves. This sparse representation acts as an explicit information bottleneck rather than merely a compact encoding. A limited number of smooth curves can preserve the coarse glyph geometry, including stroke paths, curvature, and connectivity, while lacking the capacity to reproduce fine stylistic irregularities inherited from the original outline. Curve fitting is performed adaptively. The axis is initially represented by a single cubic Bézier curve and is subdivided at the point of maximum fitting error only when needed. Capacity is therefore allocated preferentially to regions that require additional geometric detail. Across our data, a glyph is represented by approximately ten curves on average and by at most 12. If this capacity is exceeded, the least significant cues are discarded as intended. The subdivision tolerance is expressed relative to stroke thickness. Because the medial axis is defined by its distance to the glyph boundary, constraining the fitting error in this way keeps the approximation geometrically consistent with the glyph interior. The resulting representation is deliberately lossy while remaining faithful to the underlying stroke geometry.
blocks.zh: 代表性瓶颈. 接下来我们用有限的立方贝塞尔曲线 来估计被推倒的中轴线 这种稀少的表述是一种明显的信息瓶颈,而不仅仅是一种契约编码。 有限的平滑曲线可以保存粗糙的甘油几何,包括中风路径,曲率和连通性,同时缺乏复制从原轮廓继承下来的细细的花纹异常的能力. 曲线装配是适应性的。 轴线最初由单立方贝塞尔曲线所代表,并仅在需要时才被细分为最大配位误差. 因此,能力优先分配给需要更多几何细节的区域。 在我们的数据中,一个格子平均由大约10个曲线和最多12个曲线代表。 如果超过这一能力,那么最不重要的提示会按预期被放弃。 与中风厚度相对,表示分层耐受性. 因为介质轴由它与格莱弗边界的相距来定义,因此以这种方式约束适配误差使相近几何与格莱弗内地保持了相通. 由此产生的表示方式是故意失去的,同时忠于所根据的中风几何学.

blocks.en: Although pruning and curve compression remove much of the stylistic information, they cannot guarantee complete invariance. A sufficiently expressive model may still exploit residual correlations between the conditioning sketch and the target style. We therefore introduce two training-time mechanisms in UGL to make such residual information unreliable.
blocks.zh: 虽然螺旋和曲线压缩移除了大部分的花样信息,但它们无法保证完全的无变化. 一个足够表现力的模型仍然可能利用取材素描与目标风格之间的剩余关联. 因此,我们在UGL中引入了两种培训时间机制,以使这种剩余信息不可靠。

blocks.en: Perturbation during training. During training, each conditioning stroke is randomly perturbed while the corresponding target glyph remains unchanged. The model therefore does not observe a single exact skeleton as the unique conditioning representation of a target. Large-scale structure is preserved, while small local details become unreliable as predictive features. The curve representation allows us to perturb strokes structurally rather than at the pixel level. We deform the interior of each curve while keeping its endpoints fixed, preserving junctions and overall connectivity. Perturbation magnitude is scaled by curve length and correlated along the stroke, causing the stroke to bend smoothly as a whole rather than introducing high-frequency local noise. Each interior control point is displaced by a Gaussian whose standard deviation is a fraction of the curve’s chord length, capped at twice that deviation so that a curve cannot fold back on itself. We resample this fraction uniformly for every sample at every epoch, from [ 0.10 , 0.20 ] [0.10,0.20] when training UGL and from [ 0.03 , 0.08 ] [0.03,0.08] when training a Style LoRA (Table 3 ), so the model sees a range of sketch precision rather than one fixed noise level.
blocks.zh: 训练时的干扰. 在训练期间,每起调节中风会随机扰动,而相应的目标甘油则保持不变. 因此,该模型没有观察到一个单一的精确骨架作为目标的独特条件代表. 大型结构被保留下来,而小的局部细节作为预测性特征变得不可靠. 曲线的表示让我们在结构上而不是像素水平上扰动。 我们使每个曲线的内部变形,同时保持其端口的固定,保存接合点和整体连接. 扰动分级由曲线长度和中风相接而成,使中风整体平稳地弯曲,而不是引入高频局部噪声. 每个内控点被一个高斯人所取代,他的标准偏差是曲线和弦长度的一分之一,上限为偏差的两倍,这样一曲线就无法折回自己. 我们在每一个时代,从[0.10,0.20][0.10,0.20]在训练UGL时,从[0.03,0.08][0.03,0.08]在训练Style LoRA(表3)时,对每一个样本都统一地进行这个分数的再作再取,所以模型看到一系列草图精度,而不是一个固定的噪声水平.

blocks.en:
To further prevent the sketch from serving as a style condition, we exploit
the cross-font correspondence provided by the geometric recipes. Rather than
always pairing a target glyph with its own extracted sketch, we can condition
it on a sketch extracted from another font generated by the same recipe.
Although their precise medial axes may differ, the sketch and target share the
same underlying construction while belonging to different styles. This
cross-style pairing discourages UGL from using the conditioning sketch to infer
the target style.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步防止草图成为风格条件 我们利用
几何配方提供的交叉字体通信。 而不是说
总是用自己提取的素描来配对一个目标
从同一个食谱生成的另一个字体中提取的草图。
虽然它们的精确中间轴可能有所不同,但草图和目标共享
相同的基础建筑,同时属于不同的风格. 这个
交叉式配对 阻止 UGL 使用条件素描推断
目标样式。

blocks.en:
Together, geometry enrichment, style suppression, and cross-style pairing
produce a broad training distribution in which structural sketches primarily
communicate geometry rather than shape identity or style. Training UGL on this
corpus encourages it to follow the supplied structure, providing the universal
geometry prior required for open-form transfer.

blocks.en: We employ a VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework to assess generated results in the open-set regimes, where no unique paired ground truth exists: for a target structure outside the style’s own shape family there is no single correct rendering to compare against, so paired metrics such as LPIPS and SSIM are undefined. The judge is asked instead whether the requested structure is depicted and whether it is realized in the demonstrated geometric design language .
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个VLM-as-a-judge评价框架来评估开放式体系中产生的结果, 在开放式体系中不存在独一无二的对等地面真理:对于风格外的外形家族来说, 没有单一的正确渲染来比较, 因此对等的衡量标准如LPIPS和SSIM是没有定义的。 法官则被问及所请求的结构是否被描绘,是否在所演示的几何设计语言中实现.

blocks.en: Each judged candidate is presented as a single composite image with labeled panels: a top row of K = 6 K=6 style references, and a bottom row holding the target structural sketch and the candidate. References are drawn only from the style’s training rows, so the judge never sees the ground-truth target of the case it is grading. All panels are rendered at 256 × 256 256\times 256 on a common canvas, and nothing in the image or the prompt identifies the method that produced the candidate.
blocks.zh: 每个被评选的候选人被呈现为有标签面板的单一复合图像:上行为K = 6 K = 6样式引用,下行为持有目标结构素描和候选人. 参考文献只取自该风格的训练行,因此法官从未看到它正在分级的案件的地上真相目标. 所有面板均以256×256 256\times 256在普通画布上提供,图像或提示中没有任何内容能识别出产生候选人的方法.

blocks.en: We score each candidate absolutely rather than in pairs. This has two consequences we rely on: the resulting scalar does not depend on which baselines happen to be included in the comparison, and there is no left–right position bias to mitigate. To remove the remaining ordering effect, the six style references are shuffled per case with a fixed per-case permutation. The judge is instructed to return a single JSON object conforming to a strict response schema, which prevents the answer from drifting into prose and bounds the output length.
blocks.zh: 我们给每个候选人的分数是绝对的而不是对的。 这有我们所依赖的两个后果:由此产生的分级不取决于比较中是否包含哪些基线,也没有左-右位置偏差可以缓解. 为了去除剩余的顺序效果,六种样式参考书被以固定的每例排列来洗牌. 法官奉命返回符合严格响应策略的单个JSON对象,这防止了答案被漂移成活字并限定输出长度.

blocks.en:
We use the same judge configuration for the entire evaluation: all reported numbers come from gemini-3.1-pro-preview with a structured response schema and medium media resolution. Each candidate is judged in a single pass.
Scores are aggregated hierarchically, matching the rest of our protocol: samples within a case, cases within a style, then styles weighted equally.

blocks.en: G.1 User Study Setup
blocks.zh: G.1 用户学习设置

blocks.en: We complement the VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation with a human preference study. Unlike the judge, which scores each candidate absolutely , the study is pairwise : participants see two results for the same input and indicate which one is better. Relative judgments are easier for non-expert participants to make consistently than absolute ratings, and they directly answer the question of interest, namely whether our results are preferred over those of each baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一项人文偏好研究来补充作为法官的VLM评估。 与评委对每个候选人的评分绝对不同, 非专家参与者比较容易作出一致的判断,而不是绝对的评级,它们直接回答利益问题,即我们的结果是否优于每个基线的结果。

blocks.en: Each question is presented as a single composite image with labeled panels: a top row with the style references and the structural sketch, and a bottom row with two results, A and B. One result is ours and the other is produced by a baseline, both generated for the same style and the same sketch. All panels, including the two results, are rendered at the same size on a common canvas, so that the native output resolution of a method is not revealed, and nothing in the image or the text identifies the method behind a result.
blocks.zh: 每个题材以有标签面板的单一复合图像呈现:上行有样式参考和结构素描;下行有A和B两个结果. 一个结果是我们的,另一个是用一个基线产生的,既为同样的风格生成,也为相同的草图生成. 所有面板,包括两个结果,都是在共同的画布上以相同的尺寸被渲染出,这样一个方法的原生输出分辨率就不会被揭示出,图像或文字中没有任何东西能识别结果背后的方法.

blocks.en: The study contains 12 12 questions: three for each of the four baselines (MX-Font, FontDiffuser, Gemini, and GPT-Image), each on a different style, covering black-and-white fonts, decorative fonts, and pictogram styles. The sketches span held-out glyphs, non-Latin glyphs, human poses, and symbols. For each question, participants answer three multiple-choice items, on style, structure, and overall preference, each with the options Result A , Result B , and About the same .
blocks.zh: 该研究包含12个12个问题:四个基线(MX-Font,FontDiffuser,双子座和GPT-Image)各有3个问题,每个问题采用不同的样式,涵盖黑白字体,装饰字体和象形图样. 草图横跨了被搁置的格言,非拉丁格言,人的姿势和符号. 对于每个问题,参与者会回答三个多选择项目,关于风格,结构和总体偏好,每个选项都有"结果A","结果B"和"大约相同"选项.

blocks.en: To control for ordering and position effects, we prepare four editions of the questionnaire. Each edition shuffles the order of the questions, never placing the same baseline in two consecutive questions, and randomizes which side shows our result. Within every edition our result appears as A in exactly half of the questions, and the side assignment is mirrored between editions, so that any preference for a side cancels out. Participants reach the study through a single link that assigns them to one of the editions at random. Responses are anonymous, and each participant answers one edition.
blocks.zh: 为了控制订单和位置效应,我们准备了四个版的问卷. 每版都按问题顺序排列,从不将相同的基线连续放入两个问题中,随机排列哪一面显示我们的结果. 在每个版本中,我们的结果都以A的形式出现, 完全一半的问题, 副任务在版本之间反射, 这样任何偏好 一方取消。 学员们通过一个单一的链接来完成研究,该链接将学员随机分配到其中一个版本. 答复是匿名的,每个参与者回答一个版本.

blocks.en: User Study: Instructions Thank you for participating! This study evaluates geometric style transfer : the task of applying the design language shared by a few style references to a new, unseen structure given by an input sketch. The sketch specifies the target structure, whereas the references specify the style in which that structure should be realized. Each of the 12 questions shows: ∙ \bullet the style references (target style) ∙ \bullet the structural sketch (target structure) ∙ \bullet two results, A and B, generated by different methods For each question, choose which result (A, B, or about the same): ∙ \bullet Style – better matches the style of the references. ∙ \bullet Structure – better depicts the structure of the sketch. ∙ \bullet Overall – you prefer overall. Look closely at all the style references: a style is often defined by distinctive motifs that appear in only some of them.
